class.name: WebViewEditor
class.brief_description: A WebView editor component for browsing web content within the Godot editor.
class.description: WebViewEditor provides a fully functional web browser interface integrated into the Godot editor. It includes navigation controls, an address bar, and supports standard web browsing functionality. The WebView is implemented using platform-specific native web rendering engines: - Windows: Microsoft Edge WebView2 - macOS: WKWebView - Linux: WebKitGTK

method.name: get_current_url
method.description: Returns the current URL being displayed.

method.name: can_go_back
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the WebView can navigate back in history.

method.name: can_go_forward
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the WebView can navigate forward in history.

method.name: set_webview_visible
method.description: Sets the visibility of the WebView component.

method.name: is_webview_visible
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the WebView is currently visible.
